name: reflexivity
description: Research companies, themes, competitors and published insights from Reflexivity's Knowledge Graph through focused workflows and the Reflexivity research MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Company, theme and insight research from Reflexivity
interface.longDescription: Connect to the Reflexivity research MCP server and run focused workflows: brief a company on its themes, competitors and recent catalysts; find companies exposed to a theme or screen a watchlist against it; and search published catalyst, earnings and scenario insights.
defaultPrompt: Set up Reflexivity Research for me.
Brief me on Nvidia: themes, competitors and recent catalysts.
Which companies in my watchlist are exposed to electric vehicles?
